traits.d: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the death's head's next turn.

traits.d: If Ankhtepot dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Har'Akir.
If Ankhtepot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Ankhtepot has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: Ankhtepot makes four Negative Energy Burst attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Power Word Stun.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 26 (6d6 + 5) Necrotic damage.
Ankhtepot touches one creature within 5 feet. If the creature has 80 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage.

Ankhtepot casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
*At Will:* Dispel Magic, Divination, Mage Hand (hand is Invisible), Power Word Stun
*1/Day Each:* Animate Dead, Sunburst

leg.d: Ankhtepot makes one Negative Energy Burst attack.

*Strength Saving Throw:* DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Ankhtepot can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Force damage, and the target is pushed or pulled up to 20 feet straight away or toward Ankhtepot. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

Ankhtepot teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Ankhtepot at his destination space. *Failure:* 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target magically ages 10 years. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

traits.d: If Azalin dies and his spirit jar remains intact, he revives with all his Hit Points in 2d10 days in the unoccupied space nearest his spirit jar. If Azalin's spirit jar is destroyed, he instead revives in 4d10 days in Castle Avernus in Darkon.
If Azalin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Azalin makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Azalin's next turn.

Azalin casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):
*At Will:* Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Invisibility, Lightning Bolt (level 5 version), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
*2/Day Each:* Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Modify Memory, Plane Shift, Scrying
*1/Day Each:* Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill

reactions.d:
Azalin casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target creature fails its saving throw against this Counterspell, Azalin steals knowledge of the triggering spell. For 1 hour or until Azalin takes this Reaction again, Azalin can cast that spell once, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*At Will:* Counterspell

leg.d: Azalin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and makes one Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch attack.

*Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 20, up to three creatures Azalin can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of Azalin's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Azalin can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

traits.d: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it. When the plant dies, its podlings also die.
If the plant dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days. This trait doesn't function if the plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by Poison damage or its remains are sprinkled with salt.

actions.d: The plant makes three Vine attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Entrapping Pod.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four vines.

*Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the plant is grappling. *Failure:* The target is pulled into the plant's space, is no longer Grappled, and is trapped in the plant's pod. While trapped, the target has the Blinded and Paralyzed conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the pod. After 2d4 hours, the trapped target dies, and if it was a Humanoid, a Bodytaker Podling resembling it emerges from the pod.

A creature outside the pod and within 5 feet of the plant can take an action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is removed from the pod, falls in a space within 5 feet of the plant, and has the Prone condition. If the plant dies, the trapped target is no longer Blinded or Paralyzed and can escape from the pod using 5 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* An attack roll hits the plant while a podling is within 5 feet of the plant. *Response:* The plant halves the damage it takes from that attack, and the podling takes the other half of the damage.

stat.langs: Deep Speech plus one other language

traits.d: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant. The podling has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as the digested creature. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.d: The boneless needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.
The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the boneless's turns. The boneless can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling a target, the boneless can't take this action again.

bonus.d: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature within 30 feet that can see the boneless. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition. *Failure or Success:* The boneless moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

stat.langs: telepathy 60 ft. understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.d: The brain magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.
The brain has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The brain makes two Disrupting Burst attacks.

*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Psychic damage. The target can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn.

*Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of the brain's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

The brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
*At Will:* Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand
*1/Day Each:* Compulsion, Hold Person (level 3 version)
The carrion stalker makes two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target. While attached, the carrion stalker can't make Tentacle attacks against other targets.

The carrion stalker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the carrion stalker as an action.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +5 (with Advantage if the carrion stalker is attached to the target), reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned in this way, the target is infested with a carrion stalker larva. If the target is still Poisoned in this way after 24 hours, the effect ends as the larva becomes a fully grown Carrion Stalker, which bursts from the target's chest and kills it.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a carrionette, it is subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, the target has the Poisoned condition, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

*Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 11, one Humanoid the carrionette can see within 15 feet that is cursed by its Silver Needle. *Failure:* The carrionette possesses the target's body, and the target possesses the carrionette's body and has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour. While possessing another body, the carrionette and target retain their alignments; personalities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and languages known. They otherwise adopt the other creature's game statistics, though the target can't use this Soul Swap action.

The possession is undone if the target (while in the carrionette's body) deals damage to the carrionette (in the target's original body) with its Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die.

traits.d: If Chakuna dies and her heart remains intact, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Valachan. Chakuna's heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.
Difficult Terrain composed of undergrowth doesn't cost Chakuna extra movement.
If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Chakuna makes three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (3d10 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a werepanther under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points (use the Weretiger stat block). *Success:* The target is immune to Chakuna's curse for 24 hours.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.n: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage and the target receives a dire wound if it doesn't have one. While the target is wounded, its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to staunch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. *Hit or Miss:* The spear magically returns to Chakuna's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

bonus.d: Chakuna moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, she can take the Hide action.

Chakuna shape-shifts into a Large panther-humanoid hybrid or a Large panther, or she returns to her true humanoid form. Her game statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

leg.d: Chakuna moves up to half her Speed and makes one Scratch attack.

Chakuna makes one Barbed Spear attack. If Chakuna has the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.
Chakuna uses Shape-Shift to turn into her hybrid form or panther form and then makes one Bite attack. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

traits.d: Cthulhu can breathe air and water.
If Cthulhu dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks inside the Vault of Cthulhu.
Ground, air, and water in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Cthulhu is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.
If Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Cthulhu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: Cthulhu makes three Eldritch Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast Befuddlement if available or Mind Spike (level 4 version). It can replace one Eldritch Claw attack with a use of Tentacle.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (2d8 + 9) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from one of two limbs.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature Grappled by Cthulhu. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Acid damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Psychic damage taken, and Cthulhu regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):
*At Will:* Mind Spike (level 4 version)
*3/Day Each:* Dream, Geas (can target creatures through dreams)
*1/Day Each:* Befuddlement, Plane Shift (self only)

bonus.d: Cthulhu teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet, taking creatures it is grappling with it. Then each creature within 10 feet of the space it left is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 25. *Failure:* 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

leg.d: Cthulhu makes an Eldritch Claw attack.

*Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Cthulhu can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 36 (8d8) Force damage, and the target is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Cthulhu that is horizontal to it. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Cthulhu can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.d: The tree's allies can willingly end their moves in the tree's space. Allies in the tree's space have Half Cover.
If the tree dies, 2d6 Death's Head Trees regrow around the same place in 365 days unless the tree is killed by a creature under the effect of a Bless spell using a weapon that deals Slashing damage.

actions.d: The tree makes two Slam attacks.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the tree can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of the tree's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

bonus.d: Each Undead ally in the tree's space can immediately take a Reaction to gain 5 Temporary Hit Points.

stat.langs: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.d: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the dullahan and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the dullahan can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the dullahan instead.
The dullahan has Advantage on attack rolls against targets that have the Frightened condition.

actions.d: The dullahan makes two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, it dies and its head is lopped off. The head rises as a Death's Head in the space of the target's corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The head is under the dullahan's control. The dullahan can control no more than seven heads at a time.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 18 (4d8) Fire damage.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, up to three creatures within 120 feet of the dullahan that aren't Constructs or Undead. *Failure:* 13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the dullahan's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

stat.cimm: charmed; deafened; exhaustion; frightened; paralyzed; petrified; poisoned

traits.d: If Ebonbane dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks, teleporting somewhere in Shadowborn Manor. Until it revives, Ebonbane acts as a +3 Longsword when wielded by a creature.
If Ebonbane fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Ebonbane has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: Ebonbane makes three Darkflame Slash attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Possess Dead if available.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

Ebonbane raises a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse within 5 feet of itself and possesses it. The corpse wields Ebonbane and is under its control. Ebonbane gains 50 Temporary Hit Points, and its statistics are the same, except its Speed increases to 30 feet, and it can speak through the corpse using any language the corpse knew in life.

The possession lasts until Ebonbane drops to 0 Hit Points or Ebonbane ends the possession as a Bonus Action. Once the possession ends, Ebonbane can't possess the corpse again. The corpse crumbles to dust 24 hours after the possession ends.

*Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 17, one willing Humanoid within 5 feet. *Failure:* 36 (8d8) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, Ebonbane devours its soul. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Ebonbane can be restored to life only by a Wish spell. *Success:* The target attunes to Ebonbane and can wield the sword.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* Ebonbane is hit by a melee attack roll. *Response:* Ebonbane adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

leg.d: Ebonbane moves up to half its Speed and makes one Darkflame Slash attack.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature of Ebonbane's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Ebonbane. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute. *Failure or Success:* Ebonbane can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: The elder thing has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The elder thing makes two Soothing Tentacle attacks and uses Psychic Skewer.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the elder thing's next turn.

*Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the elder thing. *Failure:* 55 (10d10) Psychic damage. For 1 minute, whenever the target takes the Magic action, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. *Success:* Half damage only.

*Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Psychic damage. If the target has the Charmed condition, it gains 1 Exhaustion level and has the Stunned condition while Charmed.

bonus.d:
The elder thing casts Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, or Nondetection, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).
*3/Day:* Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, Nondetection

actions.d: Ez makes three attacks, using Hunter's Blade or Fiery Bolt in any combination.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 19 (3d10 + 3) Fire damage.

Ez casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
*At Will:* Light, Mage Hand
*1/Day Each:* Dispel Evil and Good, Lightning Bolt, Magic Circle

reactions.d:
Ez casts Shield in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*3/Day:* Shield

bonus.d: Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her has Ez's choice of (A) Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn or (B) Resistance to Acid, Necrotic, and Poison damage until the end of its next turn.

Ez chooses a damage type. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one target within 30 feet that Ez can see. *Failure:* The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target has Vulnerability to the chosen damage type. The curse ends early if Ez uses this action again.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the curse ends, Ez can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.
Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

stat.cimm: charmed; exhaustion; frightened; grappled; paralyzed; petrified; poisoned; prone; restrained

traits.d: At the end of each of the gallows speaker's turns, each creature of the gallows speaker's choice in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the gallows speaker suffers the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target takes a Reaction to make a melee attack roll against a creature within reach. If no creature is within reach, the target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
The gallows speaker can enter a creature's space and stop there.

actions.d: The gallows speaker makes two Whirling Blades attacks.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened in this way, the creature has the Deafened condition, is compelled to shriek along with the gallows speaker, and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Success:* Half damage only.

elements.name: Gennifer Weathermay-Foxgrove
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human, lycanthrope), lawful good. Challenge 3.

traits.d: If reduced to 0 Hit Points, Gennifer succumbs to lycanthropy. Her statistics are replaced by those of the Werewolf stat block, but she retains her alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; proficiencies; and languages known. She then immediately revives in her hybrid form with all her Hit Points.

actions.d: Gennifer makes two attacks, using Blessed Dagger or Radiant Wisp in any combination.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d10 + 3) Radiant damage.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Gennifer. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Radiant damage. If the target is an Undead creature, it has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

Gennifer casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
*At Will:* Light, Mending
*1/Day Each:* Locate Animals or Plants, Magic Circle, Protection from Poison

bonus.d:
Gennifer casts Healing Word, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*2/Day:* Healing Word

traits.d: If destroyed, the emissary revives with all its Hit Points in 1 day in the space of a Gibbering Mouther that was within 300 feet of the emissary when the emissary was destroyed; that mouther is destroyed.
If the emissary fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: The emissary makes two attacks, using Lashing Maw or Coagulated Nodule in any combination. It can replace one attack with Unearthly Bile if available.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Acid damage.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +15, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 44 (8d8 + 8) Acid damage.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the emissary can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 54 (12d8) Acid damage, and a Gibbering Mouther appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the target. The mouthers take their turn immediately after the emissary on the same Initiative count. Each mouther fights until destroyed. *Success:* Half damage only.

leg.d: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 23, up to two creatures the emissary can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. *Failure or Success:* The emissary can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
The emissary can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Lashing Maw attack.

traits.d: The gremishka has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* A creature within 30 feet of the gremishka casts a spell. *Response:* The gremishka regains 15 Hit Points, then becomes a Medium swarm of Tiny creatures.

stat.langs: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.d: The gug has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the gug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.d: The gug makes two Claw attacks and uses Chew.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (3d10 + 6) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from one of two claws.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, up to two Medium or smaller creatures Grappled by the gug. *Failure:* The gug places the target in its mouth and chews. A chewed creature is no longer Grappled but has the Restrained condition. While Restrained in this way, a target has Half Cover against attacks and other effects not originating from the gug and takes 10 (3d6) Piercing damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have a maximum of four creatures in its mouth at a time.

A creature in the gug's mouth can take an action to make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer Restrained and moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the gug. If the gug dies, a target is no longer Restrained and can escape from the gug using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

stat.langs: Common (can't speak in dire wolf form)

traits.d: Harkon has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.
If Harkon dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Kartakass.
If Harkon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Harkon gains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of his turns if he has at least 1 Hit Point. If Harkon takes Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

actions.d: Harkon makes two Swipe attacks. He can replace one attack with (A) Bite or (B) Enthralling Performance.

actions.n: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werewolf under the DM's control and has 50 Hit Points. The curse can't be removed until Harkon dies. *Success:* The target is immune to Harkon's curse for 24 hours.

actions.n: Swipe (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
*Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Harkon. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage.

bonus.d: Harkon shape-shifts into a Large dire wolf-humanoid hybrid or a Large dire wolf, or he returns to his true humanoid form. His game statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

leg.d: Harkon uses Shape-Shift to return to his humanoid form, then uses the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature of Harkon's choice that he can see within 30 feet of himself (creatures Charmed by Harkon automatically fail this save). *Failure:* 16 (3d10) Psychic damage. *Failure or Success:* Harkon can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.
Harkon moves up to half his Speed and makes one Swipe attack.
Harkon uses Shape-Shift to turn into his hybrid or dire wolf form and then makes one Bite attack. Harkon can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

elements.name: Hazlik
elements.desc: Medium humanoid (human, wizard), chaotic evil. Challenge 14.

stat.langs: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, Undercommon

traits.d: If Hazlik dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Hazlan.
If Hazlik fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Hazlik has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: Hazlik makes three Arcane Burst attacks.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. *Hit:* 21 (3d10 + 5) Force damage.

Hazlik casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
*At Will:* Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Light, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
*2/Day Each:* Fly, Lightning Bolt (level 5 version)
*1/Day Each:* Cone of Cold, Mind Blank (cast before combat), Scrying, Teleport

reactions.d:
Hazlik casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*3/Day:* Counterspell, Shield

bonus.d:
Hazlik manifests one of the following magic surges, targeting a creature he can see within 120 feet. While Bloodied, Hazlik manifests two surges (roll 1d4; reroll if Hazlik has already used that surge during this turn):

• 1: Misty Movement. Hazlik can teleport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see on a surface or liquid large enough to support the target.

• 2: Eye Blight. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

• 3: Mind Flare. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target can't take the Magic action until the end of its next turn.

• 4: Implode. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target takes 10 (3d6) Force damage. *Failure or Success:* Each creature within 5 feet of the target takes 10 (3d6) Force damage.

leg.d: Hazlik makes one Arcane Burst attack.

Hazlik teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space he left takes 11 (2d10) Force damage. Hazlik can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

actions.d: The inquisitor makes three Silvered Longsword attacks or uses Mind Fire three times. It can replace one attack or one use of Mind Fire with a use of Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster if available.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. Critical *Hit:* If the target is a shape-shifted creature, it takes an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

*Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature of the inquisitor's choice that it can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn. On the Charmed target's turn, the inquisitor can telepathically control the target's move and make the target take the Attack action (the inquisitor chooses the target), the Dash action, or no action.

*Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the inquisitor can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 9 (1d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the inquisitor's next turn.

The inquisitor casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
*At Will:* Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible), Sending
*1/Day Each:* Hold Monster, Modify Memory

traits.d: At the start of each of its turns, if the inquisitor has at least 1 Hit Point, it regains 10 Hit Points and can end one condition on itself.

actions.d: The inquisitor makes three Silvered Longsword attacks.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Psychic damage. Critical *Hit:* If the target is a shape-shifted creature, it takes an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage. *Hit or Miss:* The inquisitor can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

The inquisitor casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
*At Will:* Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible), Sending
*1/Day Each:* Dimension Door, Fly, Greater Invisibility
The inquisitor makes three Force Blade attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Otiluke's Resilient Sphere or Telekinesis if available.

*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 22 (4d8 + 4) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the inquisitor.

The inquisitor casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
*At Will:* Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible), Sending
*1/Day Each:* Otiluke's Resilient Sphere, Telekinesis

bonus.d: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the inquisitor can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition and is pulled up to 20 feet straight toward the Sphere's center. *Success:* Half damage only.

traits.d: If Ivan dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Borca.
If Ivan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Ivan makes two Foreleg attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Deadly Contraption.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature Ivan can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Slashing damage. *Failure or Success:* A flailing clockwork contraption attaches to the target until the start of Ivan's next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

At the start of Ivan's next turn, the device crumbles to dust and vanishes.

leg.d: Ivan makes one Foreleg attack.

Ivan spreads special caltrops to cover a 20-foot-square area within 5 feet of himself. The caltrops dissolve at the end of Ivan's next turn. Ivan can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

When the caltrops appear, each creature in the area is subjected to the following effect; a creature that enters the caltrops for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there is also subjected to this effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15 (a creature makes this save only once per turn). *Failure:* 9 (2d8) Piercing damage, and its Speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: If Ivana dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Borca.
If Ivana fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: Ivana makes two Toxic Touch attacks.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Poison damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage rises 24 hours later as a Vine Blight under Ivana's control unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Ivana. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

bonus.d: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger inanimate plant, Ivana teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger inanimate plant that is within 60 feet of the previous plant.
Ivana casts Charm Person, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15), and the duration is 24 hours.

leg.d: Ivana makes one Toxic Touch attack.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the target subtracts 1d6 from its damage rolls. *Failure or Success:* Ivana can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

traits.d:
The jiangshi has these weaknesses:

• Fear of Its Own Reflection. If the jiangshi sees its reflection, it immediately takes its Reaction, if available, to move as far from the reflection as possible.

• Susceptible to Holy Symbols. While the jiangshi is wearing or touching a Holy Symbol, it loses its Immunity to the Frightened condition and automatically fails saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

actions.d: The jiangshi makes three Slam attacks and uses Consume Energy.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the jiangshi can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* The jiangshi regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage taken, the jiangshi's Fly Speed increases to 20 feet until the end of its next turn, and it can take its Hungering Stride Bonus Action. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage rises at the end of the jiangshi's turn as a Wight under the jiangshi's control. If this wight kills a Humanoid with its Life Drain action, the wight transforms into an independent Jiangshi 5 days later.

bonus.d: The jiangshi takes the Dash action.

The jiangshi shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Beast, Humanoid, or Undead creature, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.d: Laurie makes two attacks, using Gossamer or Light Crossbow in any combination.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d8 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

reactions.d: *Trigger:* An attack roll hits Laurie or a creature she can see within 5 feet. *Response:* The triggering attack's damage is reduced by 5 (1d10).

traits.d: If the emissary fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: The emissary makes three attacks, using Lashing Maw or Invert Flesh in any combination.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Acid damage.
*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 21, one creature the emissary can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 29 (4d10 + 7) Force damage.

bonus.d: The emissary shape-shifts into a Small or Medium creature, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

leg.d: The emissary teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see and makes one Lashing Maw attack.
The emissary uses Invert Flesh.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 21, one creature the emissary can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Force damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of its next turn. *Failure or Success:* The emissary can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: If Lord Soth dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Sithicus.
If Lord Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Lord Soth has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Undead creatures of Lord Soth's choice (excluding himself) in a 60-foot Emanation originating from him have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Lord Soth can't use this trait if he has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.d: Lord Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Lord Soth can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 24 (7d6) Fire damage plus 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage.

*Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from Lord Soth. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, and the creature has the Frightened condition. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target dies.

bonus.d:
Lord Soth casts Dispel Magic, Hold Person, or Banishment (level 5 version), using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19).
*3/Day:* Dispel Magic, Hold Person, Banishment (level 5 version)

leg.d: Lord Soth moves up to half his Speed, and he makes one Forsaken Brand attack.
Lord Soth casts Command (level 3 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Commanding Magic. Lord Soth can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

stat.langs: Common (can't speak in dire wolf form)

traits.d: If the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.d: The loup garou makes two attacks, using Longsword or Rend in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

actions.n: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Werewolf under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points. The curse can't be removed until this loup garou dies. *Success:* The target is immune to this loup garou's curse for 24 hours.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.n: Rend (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonus.d: The loup garou shape-shifts into a Large dire wolf-humanoid hybrid or a Large dire wolf, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

leg.d: The loup garou moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and makes one Longsword or Rend attack.
The loup garou uses Shape-Shift, turning into its hybrid or dire wolf form, then makes one Bite attack. The loup garou can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.d: Madam Eva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: Madam Eva makes three attacks, using Cursed Dagger or Radiant Flame in any combination.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d4 + 5) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 21 (3d10 + 5) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of Madam Eva's next turn.

*Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Madam Eva can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage plus 24 (7d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of Madam Eva's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

Madam Eva casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
*At Will:* Light, Mending, Thaumaturgy
*2/Day Each:* Dispel Magic, Remove Curse
*1/Day Each:* Greater Restoration, Raise Dead, Scrying, Spirit Guardians (level 8 version)

bonus.d:
Madam Eva casts Hold Person, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*2/Day:* Hold Person

traits.d: The mi-go has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

The mi-go has a silver canister. While holding or carrying the canister, the mi-go can use its Extract Brain action.

The canister has AC 15, HP 40, and Resistance to all damage. The canister breaks if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the canister is broken, any brains inside it are destroyed. The mi-go can create a new canister after 7 days.

actions.d: The mi-go makes two Pincer attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Dazing Ray if available.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 23 (4d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) Acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature the mi-go can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Lightning damage plus 10 (3d6) Force damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of the mi-go's next turn.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature that is Grappled by the mi-go or that has the Stunned condition. *Failure:* 77 (14d10) Piercing damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the mi-go kills it, removes its brain, and places the brain in its silver canister.

The mi-go casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
*1/Day Each:* Modify Memory, Plane Shift (self only)

stat.cimm: charmed; exhaustion; frightened; grappled; paralyzed; petrified; poisoned; prone; restrained; unconscious

traits.d: The mist horror can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
While the mist horror is in fog or mist, it has the Invisible condition. The mist horror has the Incapacitated condition while it is outside an area of fog or mist.

actions.d: The mist horror makes two Mind Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Command if available.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Psychic damage.

The mist horror casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
*At Will:* Fog Cloud
*1/Day:* Command

bonus.d: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in the mist horror's space. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the mist horror's next turn.

traits.d: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the wanderer when it dies. *Failure:* The target is cursed. While cursed, the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions.
The wanderer can travel safely through the Mists to reach a specific domain it knows by name. The wanderer still can't bypass domain borders closed by a Darklord's will.

actions.d: The wanderer makes two Radiant Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike if available.
*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d10 + 3) Radiant damage.

The wanderer casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
*At Will:* Light, Mage Hand
*1/Day Each:* Augury, Detect Magic, Mind Spike

bonus.d:
The wanderer casts Hold Person, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
*1/Day:* Hold Person

traits.d: Whenever the monster is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt, and its Speed increases by 40 feet until the end of its next turn.
The monster can't shape-shift.
The monster has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.d: The monster makes two Slam attacks and uses Crush or Throw.

*Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18) from one of two hands.

*Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature Grappled by the monster. *Failure:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Restrained condition. While Restrained, the target is suffocating.

The monster throws a creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. *Failure:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

bonus.d: The monster spends 10 feet of movement to jump to a space within 40 feet that contains one or more Medium or smaller creatures. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in the monster's destination space. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Failure or Success:* The target moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.d: Lorinda can breathe air and water.
If Lorinda dies, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Tepest.
If Lorinda fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.
Lorinda can mimic noises and animal sounds. A creature that hears the mimicry can tell it is an imitation only with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Lorinda casts Slow, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Lorinda can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

actions.d: Lorinda makes two Mother's Brand attacks.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

Lorinda casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks):
*At Will:* Charm Person, Dancing Lights, Disguise Self (24-hour duration), Invisibility (self only, and Lorinda leaves no tracks while Invisible), Minor Illusion, Ray of Sickness (level 3 version)
*1/Day Each:* Augury, Blight, Plant Growth, Scrying, Unseen Servant

bonus.d:
Lorinda shape-shifts into Mother, a deity revered by the people of Tepest, for 8 hours. Her game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of Mother, Lorinda can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Person as a Bonus Action.

Lorinda reverts to her true form if she drops to 50 Hit Points or fewer.

When Lorinda reverts to her true form, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Lorinda is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14 (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws.

leg.d: Lorinda teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet and can make one Mother's Brand attack.

stat.langs: telepathy 120 ft. Common plus two other languages

traits.d: The necrichor can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
If the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

If destroyed, the necrichor revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days in the nearest unoccupied space next to a creature of its choice that it has previously possessed with its Blood Puppeteering action. This trait doesn't function if the destroyed necrichor's remains are in a vessel affected by the Hallow spell or if all the necrichor's previous Blood Puppeteering targets are dead.
The necrichor can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.d: The necrichor makes two Necrotic Burst attacks.

*Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Force damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the necrichor's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.

*Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one Bloodied creature within 5 feet. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the necrichor; the necrichor disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The necrichor now controls the target's body, but the target retains awareness. The necrichor can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect except ones that specifically target Undead. The necrichor's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores.

The possession lasts until the target drops to 0 Hit Points or the necrichor leaves it as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the necrichor appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this necrichor's Blood Puppeteering for 24 hours. *Success:* The target is immune to this necrichor's Blood Puppeteering for 24 hours.

stat.langs: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.d: The nightgaunt doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.d: The nightgaunt makes two attacks, using Claw or Barb in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Ascend.
*Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).
*Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 21 (6d6) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
The nightgaunt flies upward in a straight line, moving up to its Fly Speed. If the nightgaunt is grappling a creature, it ignores the extra movement cost to carry the creature with it.

bonus.d: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature Grappled by the nightgaunt. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the nightgaunt's next turn.

traits.d: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.d: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Failure:* The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition for 10 minutes, after which the effect ends on the target.

traits.d: If damage reduces the priest to 0 Hit Points, it receives a random boon. Roll 1d6 to determine the boon the priest receives. The priest revives at the start of its next turn with half its Hit Points, and its creature type is now Undead.

An aura of dread fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the priest. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each non-Undead creature that starts its turn in the Emanation. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn

Sticky ectoplasm slows creatures in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the priest. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature that starts its turn in the Emanation. *Failure:* The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
When the priest deals Necrotic damage to a creature, the priest gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.
The priest has a Fly Speed of 30 feet and Immunity to Fire damage.

The priest has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and it has Vulnerability to Radiant damage. Additionally, the priest can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

When the priest revives with this boon, all corpses of Small or Medium Humanoids in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the priest rise as Skeletons under the priest's control. Additionally, at the end of each of the priest's turns, each non-Undead creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the priest takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

The priest dies and this trait doesn't function if the priest receives a boon it already has or the priest's tattoo of Osybus is destroyed. The tattoo is destroyed only if the priest takes 15 damage or more on a single turn while the priest has 0 Hit Points.

actions.d: The priest makes two attacks, using Soul Blade or Necrotic Bolt in any combination.
